passives.name: When Truth is Denied
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases damage taken from Mage enemies. Takes greater damage from Earth element enemy Mages. Reduces Critical Hit Chance and Effectiveness of Striker enemies. When inflicted with Poisoned, increases Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_guild_raid_01_passive_1_2]. Reduces damage dealt to Earth enemies and increases damage taken from them, but increases damage dealt to Fire enemies and reduces damage taken from them.
